note: Forbidden: a Section 3.3 mechanism settable on neither a neighbor nor a neighbor group. TestPeersFromConfigTree_LocalASOptionsPerNeighborGroup drives PeersFromConfigTree: the group's local (65010) and replace-as reach the inheriting peer (assert.Equal LocalAS, assert.True LocalASReplaceAS), and no-prepend set on a peer reaches that peer (assert.True LocalASNoPrepend); each of the three mechanisms goes red if it cannot be configured on the basis the test uses.
